## Rule

Input 3×3: each row has exactly one `5` (rest `0`). The **column of the `5`** maps to an
output color that fills the entire row: **col0→2, col1→4, col2→3** (non-monotonic).
Officials I/O = one-hot `[1,10,30,30]`, 3×3 at top-left, background 0 elsewhere.
Verified on all 4 train + 1 test example.

## Live best + floor (2026-07-07, bo_ng_cld_worker2)

Live bar **cost 80**, sha `560f5b67…4095` (manifest, Vamshi). Live graph = single
`Einsum bkrj,bkrh,blrc,jp,po->borc` with Q[30,2]=60 + V[2,10]=20 → profile 80 (memory 0).

**This is the structural floor.** Perfect-25 cost≤1 is INFEASIBLE (output alphabet
{2,3,4} disjoint from input {0,5} ⇒ color payload forced). Single-node Einsum floor = 80
(rank-2 needed to separate 3 col-classes → Q[30,2]+V[2,10]). 2-node slice routes lose:
30×30 output is mandatory (3×3 output ⇒ visible 0/11), forcing a ≥360-B intermediate.
Full argument + attempts: `task262/hard_records/perfect25_ceiling_and_single_node_floor.md`.
